Detailed Description

Class containing the default coverage groups. These groups are setup to use the default coverage data provided by the svt_mipi_cphy_ppi_monitor_def_cov_data_callback class, with sampling triggered by the events triggered by the svt_mipi_cphy_ppi_monitor_def_cov_data_callback class.
